item.title: GUI Command and Control
item.description:
GUI Command and Control (Client + Controller)

I wanted a simple way to send system commands from a GUI and get the output back in real time. The result is a small Python command-and-control demo built on sockets with a tkinter controller. It is intentionally minimal: one GUI, a client that listens for commands, and a few safe system info queries.

item.title: Realtek Driver Updater
item.description:
Realtek Driver Updates Without the Busywork

I got tired of manually pulling from git, running make, and then installing with sudo make install every time I needed to rebuild the rtw88 driver. I wanted something cleaner — a one-stop GUI to handle the whole process with a few button clicks.
